name: Discount Mania – Conditional Discounts
author: ashiktarik

sections.description:
Discount Mania is a high-performance, conversion-focused WooCommerce extension designed to create dynamic, tiered, and conditional promotions with zero complexity. Boost Average Order Value (AOV) through intelligent Quantity Discounts, Cart Subtotal Thresholds, and Buy X Get Y (BOGO / Buy X Get Y Free or Discounted) deals.

Key Features

  • Admin Dashboard Overview Table: Bird’s-eye view of all configured discount rules with live status badges (Active / Paused).
  • Instant One-Click Pause / Resume: AJAX-driven toggle switches let you pause or activate promotions in real-time without reloading the page.
  • Modern Segmented Switch UI: Intuitive, tactile switch for percentage and fixed discount types.
  • Full Color & Display Customization: Live color pickers for primary accent, success badge, offer badges, and reward buttons.
  • Promotional Alerts: Beautiful notification cards on cart and checkout pages with animated progress bars.
  • Interactive Reward Gift Cards: Displays eligible Buy X Get Y reward items with thumbnails, discount badges, and quick claim actions.
  • Single Product Page Upsell: Automatically showcases matching Buy X Get Y promotions directly on product pages below the Add to Cart form.
  • Variable Product Intelligence: Automatically routes variable items to single product pages for option selection and simple products directly to cart.
  • Hierarchical Category Matching: Supports ancestor category matching so promotions apply across subcategories seamlessly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/discount-mania-conditional-discounts directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the WooCommerce > Discount Mania screen to configure your discount rules and customize your promotional colors.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce 6.0 or higher is required.

Can I pause a promotion without deleting it?

Yes! You can toggle the Active/Paused switch on any rule in the admin overview table or inside the rule card at any time.

Are variable products supported for Buy X Get Y offers?

Yes. If a reward product has variations (like sizes or colors), the plugin provides a “Select options” button linking directly to the product page so the customer can choose their desired variant.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Feature: Added direct “Settings” quick action link on the WordPress Installed Plugins screen.
  • Fix: Capped cumulative discounts to prevent stacked promotions from exceeding cart subtotal or resulting in negative totals.
  • Fix: Implemented item-level, tax-aware fee apportionment for accurate tax deductions in mixed and reduced-rate carts.
  • Fix: Improved Buy X Get Y fee calculation to use actual cart unit price after coupons and line discounts.
  • Fix: Updated Buy X Get Y progress notices to track total reward quantity earned across multiple groups.
  • Fix: Added strict whitelist validation on promotion rule settings (rule types, targets, discount types).
  • Fix: Added WooCommerce active dependency check with dismissible admin notice to prevent fatal errors when WooCommerce is deactivated.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release with Quantity Discounts, Subtotal Thresholds, and Buy X Get Y promotion engines.
  • Admin dashboard overview table with live AJAX pause/resume toggles.
  • Integrated color customization system with CSS variables.
  • Cart, checkout, and single product page promotional showcase widgets.
  • WordPress Plugin Check (PCP) compliance and WordPress Plugin Boilerplate structure.
